Body.Content:
What and Why:

Use the "Add explainer video" skill in Copilot for PowerPoint. This is a built-in skill rolling out as an experimental skill to Frontier users. Available on desktop, Mac, and web.

Rollout Schedule:

Frontier/Insider (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out on early November 2026 and expect to complete by mid November 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Ability to convert a static slide into an animated explainer video.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No admin action is required.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: The "Add explainer video" skill in PowerPoint Copilot, available on desktop, Mac, and web, will roll out to Frontier users worldwide from early to mid-November 2026. It converts static slides into animated explainer videos. No admin action or compliance concerns are required.
